_metadata.description: Complex defect engineering tasks V3 - requires domain knowledge
_metadata.design_rationale: Tasks requiring specialized knowledge about crystal structures and defect chemistry

tasks.description: Create a Cr³⁺ substitution at Al site in corundum (α-Al₂O₃) with correct oxidation state balance. The result should be a ruby-like structure.
Create a Schottky defect pair in rocksalt NaCl: remove one Na atom and one Cl atom to maintain charge neutrality. The vacancies should not be nearest neighbors.
Create a Cu vacancy in chalcopyrite CuFeS₂. Must correctly identify Cu sites (not Fe sites) in the ordered tetragonal structure.
Create a sulfur vacancy in the TOP layer only of bilayer MoS₂ (2H phase). Must correctly build bilayer and identify which S atoms are in the top layer.
Create an A-site/B-site antisite swap in BaTiO₃: exchange positions of one Ba and one Ti atom. This maintains stoichiometry but creates a defect pair.
Create a <110> mixed dumbbell interstitial with Fe-C pair in BCC iron. Two atoms (one Fe displaced from lattice + one C) share the region around a lattice site.
Create a trivacancy cluster in FCC aluminum: three adjacent vacancies forming a triangular arrangement on a {111} plane.
Create a Frenkel defect pair in fluorite CeO₂: one O vacancy plus one O interstitial at the octahedral site (not tetrahedral).
Create a germanium-vacancy (GeV) center in diamond: Ge substitution adjacent to a vacancy, similar to NV center but with group-IV element.
Create a nitrogen-vacancy-nitrogen (NVN) center in diamond: two substitutional N atoms flanking a vacancy along <111>.
Create a doubly-ionized oxygen vacancy (V_O) in rutile TiO₂. The vacancy creates localized electrons that reduce nearby Ti⁴⁺ to Ti³⁺.
Create a crowdion defect in BCC tungsten: a linear chain of displaced atoms along <111> direction.
Create an Fe antisite defect (Fe on Ni site) in ordered L1₀ FeNi while maintaining the layered ordering.
Create a stacking fault tetrahedron (SFT) precursor by removing 4 atoms in tetrahedral arrangement in FCC copper.
Create a silicon-vacancy (SiV) center in diamond: Si atom sitting between two vacant C sites (split-vacancy configuration).
Create a Mg dopant at a subsurface position in wurtzite GaN slab, simulating p-type doping near a surface/grain boundary.
Create a <111> divacancy in BCC iron: two adjacent vacancies oriented along the most stable direction.
Create a Ti-Al antisite pair in γ-TiAl (L1₀ structure): swap one Ti and one Al atom to create coupled antisites.
Create a self-interstitial <110> dumbbell in BCC iron: two Fe atoms sharing one lattice site along the most stable orientation.
Create an oxygen Frenkel pair in UO₂ fluorite structure with the interstitial at the correct octahedral void site.
Create an oxygen vacancy in cubic perovskite SrTiO₃ at the face-center position.
Create a Zn vacancy in wurtzite ZnO. Must correctly identify Zn sites in the hexagonal structure.
Create a Ti vacancy in rutile TiO₂ tetragonal structure.
Create a Ga vacancy in zincblende GaAs semiconductor.
